mapper.sql: FROM public.nocode_object o JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.object_id = o.id AND v.version_no = o.latest_version_no JOIN public.nocode_object_table t ON t.object_version_id = v.id AND t.table_role = 'MAIN'
mapper.select:
SELECT o.*, t.table_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.nocode_field f WHERE f.object_version_id = v.id AND f.field_state='ACTIVE' AND f.deleted=0) AS field_count
WHERE o.deleted=0 AND o.object_name ILIKE #{name} ESCAPE '!' AND o.object_code ILIKE #{code} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY o.update_time DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, v.id AS version_id, v.state AS version_state, t.id AS table_id, t.table_name
WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted=0
FOR UPDATE OF o
FOR SHARE OF o

SELECT *, (config_json->>'sort')::integer AS field_sort FROM public.nocode_field WHERE object_version_id = #{versionId} AND field_state='ACTIVE' AND object_table_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.nocode_object_table WHERE object_version_id=#{versionId} AND table_role='MAIN') ORDER BY (config_json->>'sort')::integer, stable_field_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_object_table t JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.id = t.object_version_id WHERE t.table_name = #{name} AND v.object_id != #{objectId})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_object SET object_code = #{object.objectCode}, object_name = #{object.objectName}, category = #{object.category}, description = #{object.description}, title_field_stable_id = #{object.titleFieldStableId}, updater = #{object.updater}, update_time = clock_timestamp(), lock_version = lock_version + 1, reconciliation_hash=NULL,reconciliation_version_id=NULL WHERE id = #{object.id} AND deleted=0 AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_object_version(object_id, version_no, schema_json, schema_checksum, creator, updater) VALUES (#{version.objectId}, 1, CAST(#{version.schemaJson} AS jsonb), #{version.schemaChecksum}, #{version.creator}, #{version.creator})

INSERT INTO public.nocode_object_table(object_version_id, stable_table_id, table_code, table_name, table_role, creator, updater) VALUES (#{table.objectVersionId}, #{table.stableTableId}, 'main', #{table.tableName}, 'MAIN', (SELECT creator FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{table.objectVersionId}), (SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{table.objectVersionId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_object_version SET schema_json = CAST(#{schema} AS jsonb), schema_checksum = #{checksum}, lock_version = #{revision}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updater=(SELECT o.updater FROM public.nocode_object o WHERE o.id=nocode_object_version.object_id) WHERE id = #{versionId}

UPDATE public.nocode_object_table SET table_name = #{name}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updater=(SELECT v.updater FROM public.nocode_object_version v WHERE v.id=nocode_object_table.object_version_id) WHERE id = #{tableId}

UPDATE public.nocode_field SET field_state='INACTIVE',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updater=(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}) WHERE object_version_id = #{versionId} AND stable_field_id = #{stableId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_field(object_version_id, object_table_id, stable_field_id, field_code, field_name, column_name, data_type, length_value, precision_value, scale_value, required_flag, unique_flag, config_json, creator, updater) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{tableId}, CAST(#{field.id} AS bigint), #{field.code}, #{field.name}, #{field.code}, #{field.type}, #{field.length}, #{field.precision}, #{field.scale}, #{field.required}, #{field.unique}, jsonb_build_object('sort', CAST(#{field.sort} AS integer)), (SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}), (SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId})) ON CONFLICT(object_version_id, stable_field_id) DO UPDATE SET field_code = excluded.field_code, field_name = excluded.field_name, column_name = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_object_version v JOIN public.nocode_object o ON o.id=v.object_id WHERE v.id=#{versionId} AND (o.current_published_version_no IS NOT NULL OR o.source_type='ADOPTED')) THEN nocode_field.column_name ELSE excluded.column_name END, data_type = excluded.data_type, length_value = excluded.length_value, precision_value = excluded.precision_value, scale_value = excluded.scale_value, required_flag = excluded.required_flag, unique_flag = excluded.unique_flag, field_state='ACTIVE', config_json = nocode_field.config_json || excluded.config_json, updater=excluded.updater, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO public.nocode_operation_log(trace_id, operator_id, operation_type, resource_type, resource_id, object_id, result_status, detail_json,creator,updater) VALUES (CAST(#{traceId} AS uuid), #{actorId}, #{operation}, 'DATA_OBJECT', CAST(#{objectId} AS varchar), #{objectId}, 'SUCCESS', CAST(#{detail} AS jsonb),CAST(#{actorId} AS varchar),CAST(#{actorId} AS varchar))
